name: io.github.telegraphprotocol/telegraph
description: Ask the Telegraph network's ranked miners, browse intents, miners and rankings; pay in USDC from escrow or by x402.

environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAPH_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: 0x private key of a wallet made for paying asks (USDC). Without it only the free tools work.

environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAPH_URL
environmentVariables.description: Telegraph node URL. Default: beta 2, https://devnode.telegraphprotocol.com

environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAPH_PAYMENT
environmentVariables.description: auto (escrow first, then x402), escrow or x402. Default auto.

environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAPH_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Chain RPC for the balance and deposit tools. Default: a public Sepolia RPC.
